name: application-choropleth-legend
title: Choropleth Legend
description: Map value legend in continuous gradient or stepped-bucket form, pairing a single-hue light-to-dark ramp with range labels.
useWhen: A choropleth (color-filled region) map needs a legend explaining what its color scale means.
The underlying data is a single magnitude measure (density, rate, count) mapped to one sequential hue.
Regions are colored either by a continuous scale (use the gradient variant) or by fixed tiers (use the stepped variant).
avoidWhen: The map encodes categories, not magnitude — use a categorical legend with distinct hues instead of a single-hue ramp.
The value can be negative or has a meaningful zero midpoint — use a diverging two-hue ramp instead of this sequential one.
There's no map/chart to label — this is a legend component, not a chart itself.
responsiveBehavior: The legend is a fixed-width block (16rem gradient, 18rem stepped) that fills its container up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: Value range labels are always visible text, never conveyed by color position alone.
Color swatches in the stepped variant are aria-hidden since the range labels beneath them carry the same information as text.
Uses a single sequential hue (light-to-dark) rather than a rainbow scale, keeping the mapping perceptually ordered and colorblind-safer.

variants.title: Gradient legend
variants.description: Continuous light-to-dark blue gradient bar with min/max value labels for smoothly varying map data.
accessibility: Min and max labels give the scale concrete meaning beyond just 'light to dark'.

variants.title: Gradient legend (Dark)
variants.description: Gradient choropleth legend adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Gradient endpoints are lightened relative to the light variant so the ramp stays perceptible against a dark surface.

variants.title: Stepped legend
variants.description: Four discrete color-bucket swatches with range labels beneath each, for maps that tier regions instead of using a continuous scale.
accessibility: Each bucket's range label sits directly beneath its swatch, keeping the color-to-value mapping unambiguous.

variants.title: Stepped legend (Dark)
variants.description: Stepped choropleth legend adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Swatch colors must remain perceptually ordered and distinguishable on dark surfaces.
